description: Scan Polymarket contracts for mispricings against the PMP model (a probability swarm). Returns each market where the model disagrees with the price, the direction to take, the edge in percentage points, and quarter-Kelly sizing, sorted by absolute edge. Pro key required. Use for "where is the edge today", "mispriced markets", "what should I trade".

minEdge.description: Minimum absolute edge in pp to include (default 5). Accepts a number or a numeric string ("3", "3pp", "3%").

name: scan_mispricings
title: Scan Mispricings
